requirements.title: This game needs WebGPU
requirements.body: Boon Sop: The Unbroken Debt is built for high-end desktop computers and runs only in browsers with WebGPU enabled.
requirements.minimum.value: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5700 / Apple M1 Pro · 16 GB RAM
requirements.recommended.value: NVIDIA RTX 3070 / AMD RX 6800 / Apple M2 Pro · 16–32 GB RAM
requirements.browser.value: Current Chrome or Edge · Safari on macOS 26+ · Firefox on Windows or Apple Silicon
